about_the_game:
Woven Vanquisher

"Unleash the storm and command the fury of the skies with the *Woven Vanquisher* supporter pack. As the third tier in the series, this pack is a masterful collection of awe-inspiring cosmetics that embody the primal force of lightning and the majesty of the storm. From the Tempest Gate's raw power to the *Thunderfang* Armor's electrifying elegance, this pack is for those who seek to walk the battlefield like a living storm, leaving chaos in their wake.

**Note:** This pack includes all cosmetic items from the *Woven Traveler and Woven Templar* supporter packs but does not carry over the Epoch Points from those tiers."

Woven Traveler Pack

Woven Templar Pack

Back Slot - Storm Drake's Wings

Embody the majesty of a tempest with the Storm Drake’s Wings. These dynamic, lightning-infused wings radiate power with every pulse of electric energy. Their sleek, draconic design and crackling veins of stormlight mark you as a true master of the skies.

Portal - Tempest Gate

Step through the eye of the storm with the Tempest Gate. This electrifying portal roars with the untamed energy of a thunderstorm. Surrounded by jagged rock and crackling lightning, this gateway conjures visions of the tempest bending to your will, transporting you to the heart of the storm.

Weapon - Storm Dragon Staff

Wield the tempest in your hands with the Storm Dragon Staff. This stunning staff crackles with arcs of vibrant blue lightning coursing through its draconic design. Perfect for spellcasters who channel raw elemental energy, this staff is a statement of your dominion over the storm.

Armor Set - Thunderfang Armor Set

Ascend to the pinnacle of stormborn power with the Thunderfang Armor. This regal armor set combines intricate, dragon-inspired plating with electrifying accents that crackle with storm energy. Its gleaming white and gold design makes you a beacon of majesty and raw elemental force, a true herald of the storm.

Footprint - Lightning Footprint

Leave your mark with every step. The Lightning Footprints cosmetic sparks with electric energy as you move, sending bolts of lightning across the ground and creating a dazzling trail that fades like the calm after the storm.

Evade - Stormwalker

Dodge with the swiftness of lightning. The Stormwalker evade cosmetic streaks bright arcs of electricity behind you, transforming your movements into flashes of stormborne brilliance.

200 EP

Digital currency to further customize your journey. Use these points to purchase additional cosmetics from the in-game cosmetic shop.

Woven Vanquisher Forum Badge

You were here for Season 2, and your journey is a part of your story. Showcase your travels with the Woven Vanquisher Forum Badge.
